set -e
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive NEEDRESTART_SUSPEND=1 RELEASE_UPGRADER_NO_SCREEN=1
apt-get update
apt-get -y -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confdef -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold full-upgrade
dir=$(mktemp -d)
cd "$dir"
url=http://old-releases.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/dists/lunar-updates/main/dist-upgrader-all/current
for f in lunar.tar.gz lunar.tar.gz.gpg; do
  python3 -I -c 'import sys, urllib.request; urllib.request.urlretrieve(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])' "$url/$f" "$f"
done
gpgv --keyring /usr/share/keyrings/ubuntu-archive-keyring.gpg lunar.tar.gz.gpg lunar.tar.gz
tar -xzf lunar.tar.gz
./lunar --mode=server --frontend=DistUpgradeViewNonInteractive
